name: @prabhixtechnologies/brand
description: Prabhix design tokens, Tailwind preset and SVG marks. Token source: tokens.json.
//scripts: `prepare` is tsup alone, not `build`. build also runs build-tokens.mjs, and that generator
writes into the Identity, Infra and Mobile checkouts when they are siblings of this one --
which they are on the development machine. npm runs prepare on every install, so wiring
build here would have quietly rewritten files in three other repositories every time
anyone typed `npm install`. Compiling src to dist is all that `exports` needs.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-tokens.mjs --check && node scripts/check-literals.mjs && node scripts/check-mojibake.mjs

//exports: dist for the module entry, not src, and no publishConfig swapping the two. npm's
publishConfig overrides npm config values, not package.json fields -- that is a Yarn and
pnpm feature -- so the block that used to sit here was ignored and 1.1.0 shipped pointing at
raw TypeScript. See the longer note in packages/ui/package.json.
1.1.0 still worked for Platform, which is the only consumer migrated so far, because
marketing imports only ./tailwind-preset.css. The three subpath entries below are generated
artefacts and SVGs shipped as they are, so they were never affected -- which is exactly why
a green build did not reveal this.
